notes.title: GO! GO! GO! All the QoL you wanted, now in game!
notes.content:
After too much time, here you are a full quality-of-life update that will help you go through the game!

[list]
[*] The RETREAT button in Story Mode is now available from the [b]first turn[/b] after losing against a boss and trying again. This does not apply to just [b]one[/b] specific fight in Chapter 2. Arcade Mode Chapter 2 is not affected
[*] Unlock prompts for Chapter 2 Story mode, Arcade mode and Gallery, since many players actually missed those and stopped playing at the end of Chapter 1
[*] Story CGs are now added to the Gallery, as they should have been since day 1.
[*] Minor grammar and spelling fixes.
[/list]

I hope you'll keep enjoying the game, it has been a fun ride so far!

Star Guardians?

LET'S RUMBLE!

notes.title: [BUG FIX] Missing skill for Dua in Chapter 2
notes.content:
Due to a bug in the game's logic, Dua couldn't obtain the skill Aurora Glimmer after the Echo fight in Chapter 2, if the fight wasn't won at the first attempt.

This bug is now fixed, but [b]this patch won't fix your save file retroactively[/b].

[h2]I have already beaten that boss, now what?[/h2]
The skill is [b]not mandatory[/b] to finish the game, but makes the last two fights significantly easier.
If you have already reached the second to last boss [spoiler]Pyrom[/spoiler], you can add the missing skill to your save file following this process:
[list]
[*] Open your file explorer and type in the address bar: 
[b]%appdata%\Roaming\Godot\app_userdata\8-Colors Star Guardians Plus[/b]
then press Enter
[*] Open the file [b]savedataExtra_plus.cfg[/b] located in this folder with a text editor
[*] Find the section called [SentaiMagenta]
[*] Add skill4="MagentaLight" at the end of the section, as in the following picture: 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44285949/32dc165b581954a12d1a6f5a5b2ef6530c0759c3.png[/img]
[*] Save the file and start the game
[/list]

Comment here if you are having troubles with this procedure.

Thank you very much for your patience!

notes.title: F.A.Q. - Frequently Answered Questions
notes.content:
[h3]Q: How much will the game cost?[/h3]
[b]A:[/b] 4.99USD/4.99€, adapted as a regional price.

[h3]Q: Which operating system will the game be released on?[/h3]
[b]A:[/b] Windows.

[h3]Q: What are the differences with the free game jam version?[/h3]
[b]A:[/b] In addition to the content of the jam version, 8-Colors Star Guardians Plus features:
[list]
    [*]Expanded story mode with an additional chapter
    [*]Five brand-new bosses, including the wrestling sensation Evolobster
    [*]Free Play arcade mode, with customization toggle for stat multipliers and party size
    [*]Four unlockable costume sets
    [*]One unlockable character for Arcade mode
    [*]Additional settings for changing the game's resolution 
    [*]Three new songs composed by Blast Harbour for some of the fights in Chapter 2
[/list]
[h3]Q: Which engine was the game made with?[/h3]
[b]A:[/b] Godot 4.0.

[h3]Q: Which languages is the game available into?[/h3]
[b]A:[/b] Only English is currently planned.

[h3]Q: Does the game have any voice acting?[/h3]
[b]A:[/b] No, it's not currently planned.

[h3]Q: Which devices can be used to play the game?[/h3]
[b]A:[/b] Currently, the game can be controlled only with a mouse. Joypad/keyboard support might be added further down the line.

[h3]Q: How long is the game, in terms of playtime?[/h3]
[b]A:[/b] Beating Chapter 1 and 2 of Story Mode requires anything between two and four hours, depending on your skills. Free Play mode and Arcade Mode add an additional layer of replayability to the game.

[h3]Q: What about cloud saves and achievements?[/h3]
[b]A:[/b] Both are already implemented and working
